news_items.headline: Broadcom in focus ahead of June 3 Q2 FY2026 earnings; consensus expects $2.32 EPS on $22.08B revenue
news_items.summary: Investors positioning into AVGO's June 3 earnings catalyst; analyst consensus calls for EPS of $2.32 (up from $1.58 YoY) on revenue of $22.08B (up ~47% YoY). AI chip segment projected at $10.7B.

news_items.headline: Broadcom introduces BCM68850 — first 50G home gateway SoC with integrated AI acceleration
news_items.summary: Broadcom launched the BCM68850, billed as the first 50G home gateway SoC with integrated AI acceleration, alongside the industry's first integrated 5G and Wi-Fi 8 FWA platform co-developed with Samsung Electronics.

news_items.headline: LSEG renews Broadcom partnership to expand cloud infrastructure strategy
news_items.summary: London Stock Exchange Group renewed its partnership with Broadcom, extending the company's enterprise cloud infrastructure customer base.

news_items.headline: Broadcom jumps as bullish analyst note reinforces AI-driven earnings optimism
news_items.summary: Analyst note highlighted Broadcom's Q2 revenue guide of $22B (+47% YoY) and AI chip projections of $10.7B as key drivers; stock moved higher on the day.

news_items.headline: Google, Meta, and Anthropic partnerships set stage for June 3 AVGO earnings test
news_items.summary: Broadcom holds a Google TPU deal through 2031, a Meta MTIA custom chip pact, and Anthropic's $200B commitment to Google cloud/chips — all powered by Broadcom silicon — raising investor expectations ahead of Q2 results.

analyst_consensus.recent_changes: UBS set PT of $490 on 2026-05-18 (Strong Buy, ~17% upside); S&P Global polls 47 analysts at Strong Buy consensus with avg PT $480.49; 57-analyst aggregate avg PT $477.67 with 85% buy ratio.

earnings_context.notes: Q2 FY2026 earnings due June 3, 2026 after close — 6 days away. Street expects EPS $2.32 (vs $1.58 YoY) and revenue $22.08B (vs $15.0B YoY). Last quarter (Q1 FY2026) beat with record revenue of $19.3B (+29% YoY) and AI semiconductor revenue +106% to $8.4B. Near-term earnings event is a material catalyst risk.
